hero.bioHtml: Cybersecurity professional with hands-on offensive experience — CTF competitions, HackTheBox, and RAT research — balanced with enterprise defensive work using Splunk SIEM, ELK, and AWS log analysis. Now in cybersecurity business development, bridging technical security capabilities with business needs. Bilingual in English and Thai.

paragraphsHtml: I graduated in May 2026 with a B.Sc. in Information & Communication Technology (International Program) from Mahidol University, majoring in Computer Networks.

My experience spans both offensive and defensive cybersecurity — from building real-time SIEM detection systems and analysing cloud logs during my internship at Gosoft (under CP ALL), to competing in national CTF competitions and researching Remote Access Trojans in a controlled lab environment.

I now work in cybersecurity business development at JasTel Network, connecting enterprise customers with the right security solutions — while continuing HackTheBox practice in preparation for the OSCP certification.

experience.title: IT Audit Lecturer Assistant
pointsHtml: Reviewed senior students' lab assignments on network security architecture, system development, and compliance.

experience.title: Network and Security Intern

pointsHtml: Analysed AWS WAF and CloudFront logs to evaluate cloud security posture and identify potential risks across the production environment.
Configured ELK visualisations to monitor the network status of 7-Eleven stores nationwide.

experience.title: Lecturer Assistant
pointsHtml: Conducted code reviews and graded junior students' Python assignments via GitHub Classroom, identifying logical errors and vulnerabilities.
Verified students' comprehension and provided targeted clarification on programming concepts.

projects.title: Anomaly Detection & Alerting System Utilising Splunk Free License
projects.bodyHtml: Designed and built a Splunk-based real-time monitoring system detecting Phishing, DoS, Cryptojacking, and Brute Force attacks across endpoint and network telemetry. Implemented LINE and SMTP email alerting with severity scoring and event-history context for analyst handoff.

projects.title: Remote Access Trojan (RAT) Investigation for Prevention
projects.bodyHtml: Designed and built a complete attacker–victim–C2 lab environment to study RAT behaviour under controlled conditions. Deployed and analysed C2 channel communication patterns; simulated adversary persistence and data-exfiltration techniques. Translated offensive findings into practical detection signatures and prevention controls.
